zh.what: OpenAI Academy 的 AI for Educators 是面向中小学和高等教育教师的免费学习课程；10 月 15 日公告的新增是巴西葡萄牙语版本，不是 Study Mode 今天首次上线。
zh.change: 【10/15 日期精度；24 小时边界不确定】课程把备课、活动、考核与沟通放进教师自己的工作语境。语言入口降低理解门槛，但课堂判断和任务设计仍由教师负责。
zh.use: 从官方课程入口进入学习；课堂试用时，在 ChatGPT 工具菜单选择 Study，让它一次问一个问题并等待回答。教师可以先用熟悉的题目检查提示与解释，再让学生脱离聊天记录，用自己的话写出理解和新问题。
zh.limits: Study Mode 的追问流程是既有能力，不能计成这次新功能；本文未登录课程、未在课堂实测。公告只给日期，没有具体发布时间或时区，因此不声称已证实落在截止前 24 小时内。

en.what: AI for Educators is a free OpenAI Academy course for primary, secondary and higher-education teachers. The October 15 announcement adds Brazilian Portuguese; it does not launch Study Mode for the first time.
en.change: [Oct 15, date precision; 24-hour boundary uncertain] The course covers lesson planning, activities, assessment and communication. The new language can make this guidance easier to approach while leaving pedagogical decisions with teachers.
en.use: Start from the official course link. For a classroom exercise, choose Study in ChatGPT’s tools menu and request one question at a time, waiting for each answer. A teacher can first test a familiar subject, then ask students to explain the idea and formulate a new question without consulting the chat.
en.limits: The questioning workflow is existing functionality. We did not sign into the course or conduct classroom testing. The announcement provides a date without a publication time or timezone, so exact membership in the preceding 24 hours remains uncertain.

event.summaryEn: Claude: official information in chat, with a staged rollout
event.deltaZh: 【10/14 公告；24 小时边界不确定】变化从“跳出聊天去查”转向“在对话中获得按州组织的官方信息”。公告还预告选举夜展示最新官方结果，不能把这两个未来阶段写成今天已经全部可用。
event.deltaEn: [Oct 14; exact 24-hour boundary uncertain] The planned change moves information from an external destination into the conversation, organized for the user’s state. Election-night official results are another announced stage; neither should be described as universally live today.

zh.what: Anthropic 10 月 14 日说明 Claude.ai 的美国选举信息入口：已有 TurboVote 提示横幅；本月稍后计划把 Democracy Works 收集的官方投票信息直接引入回答。这里报道产品的信息来源与交互，不提供投票地点或资格建议。
zh.change: 【10/14 公告；24 小时边界不确定】变化从“跳出聊天去查”转向“在对话中获得按州组织的官方信息”。公告还预告选举夜展示最新官方结果，不能把这两个未来阶段写成今天已经全部可用。
zh.use: 用户可在 Claude.ai 提出登记、投票地点或日期问题，沿现有横幅进入信息提供方。后续内嵌回答应能看清信息来源与地区；这是本刊的交互验收重点，而不是已验证的界面实现或准确率。
zh.limits: 面向美国 Claude.ai；新数据接入写的是本月稍后。没有公布本文可核验的精确开启时刻、完整账户范围或价格变化。本刊未登录测试；对实时制度信息仍应以当地官方渠道为准。

en.what: Anthropic’s October 14 announcement describes the information pathway in US Claude.ai: an existing TurboVote banner, followed later this month by official voting information collected by Democracy Works. This is a report on product sourcing and interaction, not voting instructions.
en.change: [Oct 14; exact 24-hour boundary uncertain] The planned change moves information from an external destination into the conversation, organized for the user’s state. Election-night official results are another announced stage; neither should be described as universally live today.
en.use: People can ask Claude.ai about registration, polling places or dates and follow the existing provider banner. For the forthcoming embedded answers, our editorial test would be whether the source and jurisdiction remain clear. That is an assessment criterion, not a verified interface feature or accuracy measurement.
en.limits: The announcement concerns US Claude.ai and schedules the new data connection for later this month. It does not establish an exact activation time, complete account coverage or new pricing. We did not test a signed-in session; local official channels remain the authority for current procedural information.

event.summaryEn: Gladly: less backtracking, clearer save and failure states
event.deltaZh: 【10/14 小节更新；24 小时边界不确定】审查员可在会话内点 Previous/Next，保留列表位置；Signals 审查自动保存，保存失败提供 Try again 或 Discard；工作流重新打开时可恢复浏览器里未保存的编辑。
event.deltaEn: [Oct 14 section update; exact 24-hour boundary uncertain] Reviewers can move Previous/Next inside a session while retaining list position. Signals reviews autosave with explicit retry/discard behavior, and reopening a workflow offers to recover unsaved browser edits.

zh.what: Gladly 是客服与 AI 会话工作台。官方发行说明的 10 月 14 日小节更新了 AI Sessions、Signals 审查和工作流编辑；页面最初发布于 10 月 7 日，不能把整页首次发布日期改写成 14 日。
zh.change: 【10/14 小节更新；24 小时边界不确定】审查员可在会话内点 Previous/Next，保留列表位置；Signals 审查自动保存，保存失败提供 Try again 或 Discard；工作流重新打开时可恢复浏览器里未保存的编辑。
zh.use: 在筛选后的 AI Sessions 逐条审查，利用列表位置判断进度；失败工作流的 Use 步骤可直接打开 Action 日志。这些改动把“去别处找原因”缩短成当前上下文内的检查，本刊未测量节省时间。
zh.limits: 自动保存不等于不会失败；来源明确保留重试与放弃路径。同页还提醒 10 月 15 日起 Gladly 提供的 WhatsApp 号码注册需要支持人员实时转交短时验证码，自有号码流程不同；上线前应确认团队操作安排。

en.what: Gladly is a customer-service and AI-conversation workspace. Its October 14 release-note section updates AI Sessions, Signals review and workflow editing. The page was originally published October 7; we preserve that distinction.
en.change: [Oct 14 section update; exact 24-hour boundary uncertain] Reviewers can move Previous/Next inside a session while retaining list position. Signals reviews autosave with explicit retry/discard behavior, and reopening a workflow offers to recover unsaved browser edits.
en.use: Review a filtered session list without repeatedly returning to it. For a failed workflow, open the Action log from the expanded Use step in the conversation review panel. These changes keep diagnosis in context; we have not measured time saved.
en.limits: Autosave still has a failure path. The same notes flag an October 15 change for Gladly-supplied WhatsApp numbers: setup requires Support to relay a short-lived verification code. Self-owned numbers differ. Check the team’s registration arrangements rather than assuming a fully self-service setup.

event.summaryZh: 72 小时补充｜Workday：一句请求之后，出现可确认的操作界面
event.summaryEn: 72-hour supplement | Workday: from a request to a confirmable action
event.deltaZh: 员工先说出目标，系统按任务呈现表单、日历、审批卡或可视化，而不要求先找出对应 Agent。公司公告称 Jev 驱动这些动态界面，并把人的确认与既有权限、政策和业务流程结合。
event.deltaEn: An employee states an outcome and the system presents forms, calendars, approval cards or visualizations for that task. The company attributes the dynamic interface to Jev, while actions follow existing permissions, policies and business processes with human confirmation where required.

zh.what: Workday 10 月 13 日发布新的 Sana 首页体验，把人事、财务和 IT 的任务与决定集中到同一入口；本条是 72 小时补充，不是今天的新发布。
zh.change: 员工先说出目标，系统按任务呈现表单、日历、审批卡或可视化，而不要求先找出对应 Agent。公司公告称 Jev 驱动这些动态界面，并把人的确认与既有权限、政策和业务流程结合。
zh.use: 例如申请休假，先表达需求，再在呈现的日期选择器确认；跨天的工作保留待办、审批与 Agent 活动。对 HCI 的实际价值是让执行前的对象、日期与下一步更容易检查，这是本刊判断，未实测效率。
zh.limits: 新 Home 体验称已可用，但管理员可决定何时启用及是否默认。Sana Concierge 是早期采用客户可用，预计 2027 年第一季度普遍提供；不能因同一篇公告就把两者写成同步全面上线。

en.what: Workday announced its new Sana Home experience on October 13, combining HR, finance and IT tasks and decisions. This is a 72-hour supplement, not a launch today.
en.change: An employee states an outcome and the system presents forms, calendars, approval cards or visualizations for that task. The company attributes the dynamic interface to Jev, while actions follow existing permissions, policies and business processes with human confirmation where required.
en.use: For leave, request the outcome and confirm dates in the resulting picker. Longer-running work can retain tasks, approvals and agent activity. Our HCI reading is that a visible object and confirmation step make an intended action easier to inspect; we have not measured productivity gains.
en.limits: Workday says the Home experience is available, with administrators choosing enablement and whether it becomes default. Sana Concierge remains for early adopters, with general availability expected in Q1 2027. These are separate availability states within the same announcement.

event.summaryZh: 72 小时补充｜千问眼镜：从记录现场走向可穿戴输入
event.summaryEn: 72-hour supplement | Qwen glasses: a wearable input surface
event.deltaZh: 10/6 已报道 9/22 亮相；本次新增是 10/13 发售报道与 N1 2899 元、Pro 3399 元起的标准套装标价。眼动、翻译等作为既有背景，不再计作新功能。
event.deltaEn: The October 6 issue covered the September 22 unveiling. The new increment is October 13 retail-launch coverage and standard-kit launch prices from RMB 2,899 / 3,399. Eye interaction and translation are background, not new features.

zh.what: 10 月 13 日的媒体发布报道介绍千问 N1 与 N1 Pro AI 眼镜，定位为个人智能体的可穿戴入口。本条是 72 小时内的中国硬件补充；未取得可直读的厂商规格原件，不把媒体转述提升为独立实测。
zh.change: 【72 小时补充】10/6 已报道 9/22 亮相；本次实质新增是 10/13 的发售报道及 N1 / Pro 标准套装标价。摄像、翻译、备忘录和 Pro 眼动/虹膜核验是既有能力背景，不再次计成今天的新功能。
zh.use: 对会议、出行或跨语言场景，先核对实际应用入口、配对手机、权限与支持地区，再验证一次具体任务如何开始、何时记录、怎样停止。这里是本刊建议的试用流程，不是声称这些状态控件已经实现。
zh.limits: IT之家列 N1 标准套装 2899 元起、Pro 3399 元起，属于中国发布时的标价，非当前库存保证；补贴条件另计。本刊未验证支付、续航、健康解读或识别准确率，也未复现媒体规格。

en.what: October 13 launch coverage describes Qwen N1 and N1 Pro AI glasses as wearable entry points for a personal agent. This is a China hardware supplement within 72 hours. We lack a directly readable manufacturer specification and do not treat coverage as independent hands-on evidence.
en.change: [72-hour supplement] Our October 6 issue covered the September 22 unveiling. The new increment is October 13 retail-launch coverage and standard-kit pricing. Capture, translation, memos and Pro eye/iris features remain background, not newly launched features.
en.use: For meetings, travel or translation, our suggested trial starts by checking the actual app entry, paired-phone requirements, permissions and region. Then inspect how one task begins, records and stops. These are editorial evaluation steps, not claims that particular status controls are implemented.
en.limits: IT Home lists launch prices from RMB 2,899 for N1 and RMB 3,399 for Pro standard kits in China, excluding subsidy conditions and any stock guarantee. We did not verify payments, battery life, health interpretation or recognition accuracy.
